title: EPCOT Explorer
intro: [excited] Welcome, explorers! Tonight's whole board lives inside one giant golf ball of a park: EPCOT! Rides, pavilions, festivals and one very bitter soda. [laughs] Strap in, it's going to be educational AND fun.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A gleaming silver geodesic sphere at twilight beside a glassy lagoon, futuristic pavilions with glowing pyramids, colourful fountains leaping into the air, a monorail beam curving through the sky.

categories.title: We Are Groot
categories.intro: Our film category is the movie behind EPCOT's wildest coaster. [excited] It's Guardians of the Galaxy! Hit play on that mixtape.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A vintage portable cassette player with orange foam headphones floating in deep space, swirling purple and teal nebulas, a small potted sapling glowing beside it.

clues.clue: In Guardians of the Galaxy, this walking tree only ever says three words: 'I am' ... his own name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Groot! [laughs] Three words, endless emotional range. Honestly, more than most of us manage on a Monday.

clues.clue: Peter Quill's beloved cassette tape of 1970s hits is labeled with this two-word name, Vol. 1.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Awesome Mix! [chuckles] Cosmic Rewind at EPCOT even plays a random song from the mix on every ride.

clues.clue: Peter Quill really wants everyone to call him by this legendary outlaw name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Star-Lord! [laughs] Nobody calls him that at first. Legendary outlaw, zero name recognition.

clues.clue: Gamora, the deadliest woman in the galaxy, is the adopted daughter of this purple Mad Titan.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Thanos! [sighs] Worst dad of the galaxy. Even worse than Yondu, and Yondu threatened to eat people.

clues.clue: Peter Quill dances across a ruined alien planet in the film's opening credits to 'Come and Get Your Love' by this band.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Redbone! [excited] Blue Swede's 'Hooked on a Feeling' is the other famous tune, so don't feel bad if you got hooked.

categories.title: Ride Into Tomorrow
categories.intro: Next up, Ride Into Tomorrow! These are the rides in EPCOT's forward-thinking neighborhoods. [whispers] Please keep your hands inside your concept vehicle.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sleek futuristic test car racing along a glowing outdoor track loop, a hang-glider silhouette soaring over a giant screen of clouds, a greenhouse full of giant tomato vines, all in a bright retro-future style.

clues.clue: On this EPCOT ride in The Land pavilion, you hang beneath a giant dome screen as if gliding over famous places around the world.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Soarin'! [whispers] Take a deep breath over the orange groves. Yes, they really pipe in the smell.

clues.clue: This EPCOT ride, reopened in 2025, sends guests in a futuristic test car speeding around an outdoor loop.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Test Track! [excited] Its 2025 version is packed with tributes to the old World of Motion ride. Vroom vroom, nostalgia!

clues.clue: Opened at EPCOT in May 2022, this was Disney's first roller coaster to launch riders backwards.
clues.answer: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind
accept: guardians of the galaxy: cosmic rewind
guardians of the galaxy cosmic rewind
choices: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind! [laughs] The cars spin to face the action, so you never miss a single scream.

clues.clue: At this EPCOT show inside The Seas, a surfer-dude sea turtle chats live with kids in the audience.
choices: Finding Nemo: The Big Blue and Beyond
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Turtle Talk with Crush! [chuckles] It opened in 2004, and he's been answering 'do you know Nemo' questions ever since. Totally, dude.

clues.clue: This EPCOT boat ride passes greenhouses where a single 'tomato tree' set a Guinness record by growing over 32,000 tomatoes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Living with the Land! [gasps] Over 32,000 tomatoes in about 16 months. That's a LOT of salsa. It opened in 1982 as Listen to the Land.

categories.title: EPCOT Up Close
categories.intro: Time for EPCOT Up Close! I'll start zoomed way in on a real EPCOT landmark and slowly pull back. [whispers] Buzz as soon as you know where you are.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A vintage brass magnifying glass hovering over a futuristic theme park at golden hour, the lens showing crisp detail of a faceted silver sphere while everything else is softly blurred.

clues.clue: Name this EPCOT icon.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Spaceship Earth! [excited] The 'golf ball' is covered in 11,324 shiny facets, and rain drains through it into the lagoon.

clues.clue: Name this EPCOT pavilion, home of a certain purple dragon.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Imagination! pavilion! [chuckles] Those glass pyramids house Figment. One little spark, one giant pyramid.

clues.clue: Name this EPCOT pavilion, home to Soarin' and a famous greenhouse boat ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Land! [laughs] Fun fact: the giant skylight roof lets real sunlight reach the plants growing inside.

clues.clue: Name this EPCOT attraction, where you can choose an Orange or a Green training mission.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mission: SPACE! [whispers] Orange spins you in a centrifuge. Green doesn't. Choose wisely.

clues.clue: This golden-domed EPCOT pavilion closed as a regular attraction in 2007 and later hosted festival events. What was it called?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Wonders of Life! [sighs] It was home to Body Wars and Cranium Command. Later it hosted festival events. RIP, little dome.

categories.title: Festival Season
categories.intro: Our parks category is Festival Season! EPCOT throws a party almost every month of the year. [excited] Grab a passport and a fork.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sunny lagoon promenade lined with festival food booths, colourful flower beds shaped into whimsical animal topiaries, paint easels and twinkling holiday lanterns.

clues.clue: Each spring, EPCOT fills with giant topiaries of Disney characters during this festival.
accept: epcot international flower and garden festival
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Flower and Garden Festival! [laughs] Mickey made out of shrubs. Peak horticulture.

clues.clue: Booths called Global Marketplaces serve small plates from around the world during this fall EPCOT festival.
accept: epcot international food and wine festival
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Food and Wine Festival! [excited] My strategy: one of everything. My doctor's strategy: please don't.

clues.clue: At this winter festival, which debuted in 2017, EPCOT's Food Studios serve dishes as pretty as paintings.
accept: epcot international festival of the arts
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Festival of the Arts! [chuckles] It's the only time eating a painting is encouraged.

clues.clue: EPCOT's International Food & Wine Festival was first held in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1996! [laughs] The first one ran for about a month that fall. Now it's a months-long snack marathon.

clues.clue: During EPCOT's Festival of the Holidays, Italy's storyteller is this kind old witch who brings gifts on Epiphany.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is La Befana! [whispers] She sweeps the floors on her way out, too. Santa could never.

categories.title: EPCOT Insider
categories.intro: Our fan category is EPCOT Insider. [mischievously] Time to find out who actually reads the park map.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. An open vintage park guidebook on a café table beside a fizzy sampler of tiny soda cups, a compass and a small silver sphere paperweight, World Showcase lights glowing in the background.

clues.clue: At The Seas, you ride a clamshell vehicle to find this little lost clownfish.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Nemo! [laughs] Spoiler alert: he's found. Again. Every few minutes, actually.

clues.clue: World Showcase circles the lagoon with exactly this many country pavilions.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 11! [excited] From Mexico to Canada, that's about 1.2 miles of walking. Wear the comfy shoes.

clues.clue: At Club Cool, guests sample free sodas from around the world, including this famously bitter one from Italy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beverly! [laughs] It's the only drink that has survived every Club Cool lineup, mostly so people can prank their friends.

clues.clue: Since 2021, EPCOT's four neighborhoods are World Celebration, World Discovery, World Nature and this one.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is World Showcase! [chuckles] Future World was split into three neighborhoods, but the countries kept their classic name.

clues.clue: Spaceship Earth's shiny skin is made up of exactly this many silver facets.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 11,324! [gasps] Math says it should be 11,520, but supports and doors steal a few triangles. Spaceship Earth is not great at sharing.
